posts.summary: WeedNet, a foundation model for global-to-local weed species identification trained on 14 million images of 1,593 species, published in Nature Communications.
Shares a resource for agricultural robotics researchers; the post text does not describe the resource itself.
Welcomes a summer cohort of AI+X researchers at Iowa State and looks forward to their summer research accomplishments.
At CVPR 2026, joined a panel with Gary Bradski and others and presented agentic visual reasoning for agriculture; Tirtho Roy presented his first poster.
Former PhD student Dr. Homagni Saha joins IIT Kharagpur as a faculty member.
KCCI news covers the AI+agriculture work from the AIIRA and COALESCE projects, including an AI tool to help farmers identify pests.
New paper on AgGym, an open-source modular Gym environment simulating biotic stress spread and yield loss to evaluate management strategies such as RL.
Launch of the first Iowa statewide high school AI hackathon, organized with AIIRA at Iowa State University.
Iowa State team selected under the DARPA Ag x BTO program to develop an early warning system for biological threats to US agriculture.
posts.grantMatch: BIO-SHIELD: BIOlogical threat Surveillance through Holistic Information fusion for EarLy warning and Decision support (as PI) sponsored by DoD ($500,000, Dec 2025 – Aug 2026)

posts.summary: Hooded new PhDs Dr. Ashutosh Nirala and Dr. Ibne Farabi Shihab at the December 2025 commencement.
The lab's work is highlighted in Iowa State University's 2025 Year in Review.
Announces hosting Voxel51's in-person AI4Ag meetup in Ames, with TrAC, AIIRA and COALESCE.
New paper on bidirectional linear recurrent models for sequence-level multisource (multimodal time-series) fusion.
Invites people to an industry-academia AI+X symposium (AI4ward) in Ames the following week.
Thanks Chris Cournoyer for her support and encouragement; the photo shows her with a group of students.
Congratulates Rajan Thakulla on selection to the 2025 REU-TrACE undergraduate research program at TrAC and looks forward to hosting him.
Thanks Chris Cournoyer for supporting TrAC's effort to build an industry-academia nexus to make Iowa AI-ready.
ICCPS 2025 paper using an RL agent to generate synthetic data that improves spatial reasoning of vision-language models; presented by Joshua Waite.
Commends Aditya Balu; attached images show TrAC's "Literacy in Emerging AI Techniques" digital credential from Iowa State.
USA Today article on how AI can help farmers produce more with fewer resources highlights AIIRA and TrAC efforts.
Promotes the 2025 TrAC Research Experience for Undergraduates (REU-TrACE) opportunity in AI+X research.
Soumik Sarkar receives the Presidential Early Career Award for Scientists and Engineers (PECASE), nominated by NSF.
posts.award: Presidential Early Career Award for Scientists and Engineers (PECASE)

posts.summary: Provost Jason Keith visits the Translational AI Center to discuss the future of AI research and education at Iowa State.
Lab contributes to a new data resource for the Ag-AI community, combining UAV and satellite imagery across Iowa and Nebraska field sites.
Recap of MLCAS 2024 at IPPS8: 150+ attendees, six speakers, 30+ contributed talks and posters, and a panel.
Announces TrAC's summer AI bootcamp for beginners at Iowa State University.
Announces the Sixth MLCAS workshop on October 7, 2024, a pre-conference event of IPPS8 at Nebraska Innovation Campus, Lincoln.
Hooded new PhDs Dr. Xian Yeow Lee, Dr. Sin Yong Tan and Dr. Russell Tan at Iowa State's Spring 2024 commencement.
Credits Joshua Waite's work for an outcome of the NSF ASTERS active-shooter project, looking ahead to its future.
New paper applying scientific machine learning (SciML) solutions to complex geometries.
SaTML 2024 paper on fast certification of vision-language models such as CLIP using incremental randomized smoothing.
Thanks students, faculty and industry partners who took part in the inaugural TrAC Day at Iowa State.
Promotes another AI bootcamp run by the Translational AI Center.
ASME TechCast podcast episode recorded with Soumik Sarkar on ultra-precision agriculture.
Recap of MLCAS 2022 organized by TrAC, thanking sponsors and John Deere CTO Jahmy Hindman for his plenary talk.
Congratulates Anwesha Sarkar on her first NSF grant.
Announces MLCAS 2022 at Iowa State (Oct 10-11) themed on digital twins for precision agriculture, with a soybean pod counting challenge.
Iowa Soybean Association joins the AIIRA and COALESCE projects to connect with growers and address AI adoption barriers.
Launches the MLCAS 2021 Crop Yield Prediction Challenge for predicting soybean yield from genotype and weather data.
Shares an Iowa State "Women in Cyclone Engineering" feature on Anwesha Sarkar.
ICML 2021 paper on cross-gradient aggregation for decentralized deep learning from non-IID data.
PLOS ONE paper on LSTM-attention crop yield prediction integrating genotype and weather data from 103,365 performance records.
Computational Materials Science letter on 3D CNN-based interatomic force-field design for high-entropy alloys.
Congratulates Homagni Saha on completing his PhD work at the intersection of machine learning and robotics.
Lab presents deep learning for topology optimization at NVIDIA GTC 2021 (session by PhD student Jaydeep Rade).
NeurIPS 2019 workshop paper on semantic domain adaptation for deep classifiers via GAN-based data augmentation.
NeurIPS 2019 work on spatiotemporally constrained action-space attacks on deep reinforcement learning agents.
NeurIPS 2019 work on higher-order moments in the Adam optimizer.
New NSF project studying active shooter situations in schools.
posts.grantMatch: CPS: Medium: Collaborative Research: Active Shooter Tracking & Evacuation Routing for Survival (ASTERS) (as ISU PI) sponsored by NSF ($649,982, 10/1/19-9/30/2022)

posts.summary: Scientific Reports article on a deep learning framework for design and analysis of surgical bioprosthetic heart valves.
Start of an ARPA-E DIFFERENTIATE project with NREL and Stanford on machine learning for inverse design of photovoltaics.
posts.grantMatch: Context-aware learning for inverse design in photovoltaics (as Co-PI) sponsored by ARPA-E ($2,000,000, 4/15/2020 - 4/14/2022)

posts.summary: ICCV 2019 paper on semantic adversarial attacks generating natural image perturbations that break deep learning models.
Announces MLCAS 2019, the second workshop on Machine Learning for Cyber-Agricultural Systems, September 11-12, 2019 at Iowa State.
CVPR 2019 SkelNetOn workshop paper on multi-resolution 3D CNNs, presented by Sambit Ghadai and Xian Yeow Lee.
CVPR 2019 workshop paper on attribute-controlled traffic data augmentation, presented by Ameya Joshi and Amitangshu Mukherjee.
Soumik Sarkar's tenure and promotion to Associate Professor at Iowa State becomes official.
Keynote speech at AFITA/WCCA 2018 at IIT Bombay on October 25, 2018.
Invited keynote at AFITA/WCCA 2018 in Mumbai, where the lab also hosts the first MLCAS workshop.
NeurIPS 2018 paper on online robust policy learning with unknown adversaries, by Aaron Havens and Zhanhong Jiang.
Demonstrated a deep learning iPhone app for soybean disease detection at the 2018 Farm Progress Show, meeting Secretary of Agriculture Sonny Perdue.
Shares a European Parliament news item on EU-wide liability rules for robots and AI.
Soumik Sarkar receives the 2017 AFOSR Young Investigator Program (YIP) award.
posts.grantMatch: Neural-Symbolic approach to Real-time Decision-making in Complex Aerospace Systems (as PI) sponsored by AFOSR - Young Investigator Program ($360,000, 5/1/2017 – 4/30/2020)

notes:
Scope: 78 own posts (kind=="post"); 55 reposts ignored. All 122 image files were viewed. Every <postId>-1.jpg (59 files) is the same TrAC profile banner (identical sha256), not post media; excluded. The Voxel51 file (7381552241305989120-2.gif) is an animated flyer (Nov 6, 2025 Iowa AI/ML/CV meetup, Digital Ag Innovation Lab, Ames; Sarkar listed as speaker) and was excluded as a flyer.
CHECK 1 - PECASE: post 7285413277696696321 (Jan 2025) announces Sarkar received the PECASE. It is NOT among the four bio awards; add it to the bio/awards list.
CHECK 2 - DARPA Ag x BTO (post 7410944467828039680, Dec 2025) was matched to BIO-SHIELD (site: sponsored by DoD, $500,000, Dec 2025 - Aug 2026). The post names neither the project nor an amount; the match rests on topic (early warning for biological threats) and timing. Confirm, and consider changing the sponsor text to DARPA.
CHECK 3 - AFOSR YIP post (6191969737178632192) is classified as award (matches bio award "AFOSR Young Investigator 2017") and its grantMatch is the AFOSR YIP-funded Neural-Symbolic grant on the PI page.
CHECK 4 - Post 6965820781285060609 congratulates Anwesha Sarkar on her first NSF grant (attached screenshot: NSF award 2223689, PI Rizia Bardhan, Anwesha Sarkar co-PI). Soumik Sarkar is not on it, so it is not listed in newGrants. Same for 6833480498854137856 (feature on Anwesha Sarkar), classified as other.
CHECK 5 - newGrants is empty: every lab grant mentioned in posts (ASTERS, ARPA-E PV inverse design, PIIR Big Data, AFOSR YIP, BIO-SHIELD/DARPA) already exists on the site. No post states a grant amount.
CHECK 6 - People: Ibne Farabi Shihab (hooded Dec 2025) is not in people.json; check whether he was a lab PhD student or a co-advisee. Name spellings differ between posts and people.json: "Sambit Ghadai" (post) vs "Sambit Gadhai" (people.json); "Xian Yeow Lee" vs "Bernard Lee Xian Yeow"; "Sin Yong Tan" vs "Sin Yong Tan (Evan)"; "Russell Tan" vs "Russell Kai Liang Tan"; "Ashutosh Nirala" vs "Ashutosh Kumar Nirala". Rajan Thakulla (2025 REU) is not a lab member.
CHECK 7 - Gallery: 24 picks. Captions name people only when the post names them, and do not say who is who in multi-person photos. Points to verify: (a) 6986746719384346624-2: the speaker is likely Jahmy Hindman (thanked in the post for the plenary), but the photo does not confirm it. (b) 6915284155719114752-2: the post text reads like an Iowa Soybean Association release, so the portrait may be an ISA photo. It probably shows Sarkar and Baskar Ganapathysubramanian (unconfirmed). Fix the credit/caption or drop it. (c) 7355845271928410113-2: probably Chris Cournoyer with summer students, possibly at the Iowa Capitol (location not stated). (d) 7470572643738644480-2/-3: the post does not say what program the summer cohort belongs to (possibly REU-TrACE). (e) Image resolution: most LinkedIn multi-image posts downloaded at 480 px wide (CVPR 2026, MLCAS, TrAC Day, hooding Dec 2025), which may be too small for large gallery tiles. Single-image posts are 1280 px.
No post explicitly credits a photographer, so all credits are "Photo: Soumik Sarkar via LinkedIn".
Excluded images: article/link-preview thumbnails (WeedNet, KCCI, ISU campus, USA Today, LRU figure, PLOS, arXiv blank, PECASE headshot, MLCAS2022 speaker headshot, The Verge, Flipboard, Spark chart, IEEE Spectrum, Wired, EU robot), paper figures (AgGym, data-resource maps), flyers/graphics (hackathon, Ag x BTO logo, REU flyer, bootcamp flyer, Voxel51 GIF, GTC21 slide, AI literacy badge, credential screenshot, ASTERS quote card, TrAC banner), personal documents (Rajan Thakulla REU offer letter), the NSF award-page screenshot, the Anwesha Sarkar lab portrait (not lab), autonomous-truck expo photos from CVPR 2026 (not lab content), and the second Dec 2025 hooding photo (near-duplicate).
Low-content/unclear posts: 7481088468433952769 (resource not named), 6078206609346093056 and 5872870677198970880 (bare links), and 5993992105649790976 (GTC 2015 RGBD talk link, unclear whether it is lab work). Duplicate posts: 6122950547260588032/6122950428423368704 (intern ad) and 6108624486095994883/6108624105811034112 (TIPS review). Some posts appear to be quote-shares of others' posts with short commentary (e.g. 7323885056014397440, 7282848798924546048, 7191092851236040704, 6814250379438624769); summaries rely on the visible text plus attached images.
